svg.text: Dependency graph of the Lean development
Each box is a module; an arrow A → B means a declaration in A uses a declaration in B (kernel-level, from the compiled environment).
Arrow thickness = number of declaration-level uses. The bar in each box is the module's source mix: DASHI · Wikidata · original.
83 modules · 206 module-to-module edges · 9832 declaration-level uses · longest dependency chain: 9 modules. Rows are dependency depth: the bottom row depends on nothing else in the project.
